dct_description_sm: Contained within the National Parks, 1961 to 1994, Atlas of Canada series, is a map that shows Jasper National Park. The map shows general reference data such as roads, railways and drainage, with a particular focus on glacial features. All parts of the map area contain topographic data (with the contour interval being 200 metres). Many peaks are named, and often have their elevations shown (with data in metres). Shaded relief is used on the map. The map contains data of particular interest to park visitors such as detail about trails and more names in popular parts of the parks.
